verified_repairs.change: Added missing canonical healthy/normal-variation class normal_late_flower_senescence.
Added dedicated normal_late_flower_senescence coverage record linked to CAM-018.
Normalized old alias normal_late_flower_fade to normal_late_flower_senescence.
Replaced unrelated late-flower-fade next action with beneficial/non-pest arthropod collection action.
Restored campaign definitions already referenced by active coverage records for beneficial arthropod hard negatives, mechanical injury, and molecularly grounded virus-like syndromes.

Added evidence-grounded hard differentials for N-vs-S deficiency, rice-root-aphid-vs-fungus-gnat, light-stress-vs-iron-deficiency, phosphorus-deficiency-vs-leaf-spot, and intersex-vs-normal-female-flower structure.

Added a benign/developmental morphology hard-negative lane for stable variegation, revegetation, foxtailing, fasciation, seeded flowers, normal bract variation and related nonpathological variants, plus a variegation-vs-virus-like guardrail.

historical_gap.finding: Before repair, Collection_Campaigns contained only CAM-001..018. AUD-030 says campaigns 023-030 were added, but surviving spreadsheet revisions 155 and 188 and the pre-repair current state do not contain CAM-023 or CAM-030; no exact historical definitions were recoverable.
historical_gap.decision: Do not reconstruct historical campaigns from guesses. Preserve the discrepancy as an audit gap and create/restore campaigns only from current controlled coverage requirements or a recovered archived source.

remaining_primary_training_gaps: Physically acquired, hashed and rights-cleared public cannabis reference-image objects remain the largest controlled asset gap; the registry currently tracks candidates but production display/training admission still requires binary acquisition and item-level rights/quality/hash gates.
Large real cannabis phone-image corpora remain weak for root disease, abiotic stress, pests, healthy controls, benign developmental morphology and multi-label cases.
PCR/lab-paired HLVd and virus-like positive/negative/mixed cases remain required for etiologic validation.
Locked real-world cannabis benchmark population remains incomplete.
training_policy: Publicly viewable media is not automatically reusable training media.
Preserve item-level license, attribution, source family and hash for every acquired asset.
Do not convert reference-only or lab-dependent evidence into a definitive image-only class.
Keep healthy, normal-variation, benign developmental morphology, beneficial/non-pest, OOD and unusable-image hard negatives in evaluation and training design.
Prevent plant/session/source-family leakage across train, validation and locked benchmark partitions.
